mapper.select: SELECT dictionary_no, dictionary_nm, dictionary_content, dictionary_category, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_finance_dictionary ORDER BY dictionary_no DESC
SELECT dictionary_no, dictionary_nm, dictionary_content, dictionary_category, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_finance_dictionary WHERE dictionary_no = #{dictionary_no}
